evidence_classes.official: A dated statement from an Indian government or regulator source. It describes the source's scope, not Chetana's performance.
evidence_classes.observed: A privacy-safe aggregate produced from Chetana's own event ledger. Empty means no qualifying observations, not zero fraud.
evidence_classes.pilot_derived: A result measured inside a named, source-tagged Chetana pilot. No pilot-derived result is published until the pilot exists.
evidence_classes.pending_evidence: A material claim that Chetana has not established and will not imply.

observatory.title: India Scam Readiness Observatory
observatory.description: A source-labelled view of India's reported cyber-fraud pressure, official response rails, and what Chetana has or has not measured.
observatory.method: No composite score is published. Figures from different reporting systems, periods, and definitions are kept separate.

official_metrics.label: Cybercrime incidents registered on NCRP
official_metrics.caveat: Portal incidents are reports, not convictions, unique victims, or Chetana-detected scams.

official_metrics.label: Citizen cyber-fraud losses reported
official_metrics.caveat: This is amount reported through NCRP and CFCFRMS, not an estimate of every loss in India.

official_metrics.label: Amount saved through CFCFRMS
official_metrics.source_title: Ministry of Home Affairs: Cyber Security and Financial Fraud Combat
official_metrics.caveat: The ministry reports this across more than 23.02 lakh complaints. It is not attributable to Chetana.

official_metrics.label: Bank-reported card/internet fraud cases
official_metrics.caveat: RBI says the data cover frauds of Rs 1 lakh and above reported in the period; cases may have occurred earlier. The Rs 520 crore amount involved is not necessarily consumer loss or fully diverted.

official_metrics.label: Mobile numbers flagged through Chakshu and deactivated
official_metrics.source_title: Department of Telecommunications: Sanchar Saathi update
official_metrics.caveat: This is a DoT programme outcome, not a count of unique scammers or a Chetana data source.

official_metrics.label: Haryana NCRP cyber-fraud incidents
official_metrics.caveat: This cumulative, non-normalised figure is pilot context only. It must not be used as a state ranking or current incidence rate.

pending_claims: Chetana has not established population-level detection accuracy.
Chetana has not established prevented financial loss or recovery attributable to the product.
Chetana has no privileged access to I4C, CFCFRMS, FRI, RBI, bank, police, telecom, or government suspect data.
Chetana has not completed an independent field evaluation.

pilot.name: 30-day Digital Kavach Pilot
pilot.promise: Help one defined audience pause, inspect, and reach the correct official rail before or immediately after a suspected scam.
fixed_scope: One named audience in one geography, branch cluster, campus, workforce, or merchant network.
One agreed set of source-tagged QR, link, poster, or WhatsApp entry points.
Chetana's existing screenshot, text, voice, QR, UPI, and payment-proof checking surfaces.
Sponsor-safe aggregate PilotTrace reporting; no sponsor-visible raw scam content by default.
A final written continue, change, or stop decision packet.

timeline.name: Contract
timeline.detail: Freeze audience, source tags, owner, privacy boundary, escalation rails, and acceptance measures.

timeline.name: Launch
timeline.detail: Publish the agreed entry points and verify every QR, link, language, and reporting path.

timeline.name: Observe
timeline.detail: Review aggregate use, quality rows, feedback buckets, high-risk pauses, and official-rail taps.

timeline.name: Decide
timeline.detail: Deliver PilotTrace, limitations, incidents, lessons, and a written scale, revise, or stop recommendation.

measures: feedback, false-safe complaints, and false-alarm reports
invalid, duplicate, synthetic, and out-of-window rows
not_included: A guaranteed reduction in fraud loss, recovery rate, or complaint volume.
Production access to a bank, government, police, telecom, or payment system.
Raw screenshots, messages, phone numbers, UPI IDs, URLs, identities, or user profiles delivered to the sponsor.
A regulator, government, bank, RBI, NPCI, I4C, CERT-In, or police endorsement.
Pricing, procurement, DPA, SLA, warranty, liability, or integration terms without authorised written approval.
stop_conditions: A material privacy or security boundary is breached.
Campaign copy implies endorsement, guaranteed protection, or unsupported efficacy.
Official recovery routes are unavailable or materially misrepresented.
The sponsor requests raw user content without a separately reviewed consent and research contract.
Evidence quality is too weak to support a decision.

trust_room.plain_position: Chetana is an independent advisory scam checker. It is not a bank, government service, law-enforcement system, regulated fraud registry, or substitute for official reporting.
implemented: Local-first deterministic risk contract with no safe verdict and a low-signal abstention path.
Source-tagged field links and sponsor-safe aggregate PilotTrace reports.
Signed, publicly verifiable regression-suite integrity receipts with explicit proof limits.
No sponsor-visible raw scam text, screenshots, phone numbers, UPI IDs, URLs, or user profiles by default.
Encrypted, bounded Partner Desk conversations with deletion, retention, integrity, and approval gates.
Official 1930, NCRP, Chakshu, RBI CMS, SEBI, UIDAI, consumer, emergency, and domain-specific help rails.
open_blocks: No ISO 27001, SOC 2, CERT-In empanelled audit, independent penetration test, or independent field validation is claimed.
No Indian lawyer has approved the pilot contract, procurement posture, advertising, DPA, SLA, or liability terms.
Authenticated outbound email from Active Mirror is not configured; operator email alerts remain queued.
Host compromise, disaster recovery, key escrow, multi-node availability, and formal incident-response operations have not been independently audited.
No privileged government, bank, telecom, police, or payment-network intelligence integration is live.
